title: Equipment and capabilities
metaDescription: Sato owns and operates its own plant and equipment, which lets us mobilise quickly and control quality and schedule on site.

body: Sato owns and operates its own plant and equipment, which lets us mobilise quickly and control quality and schedule on site.
The schedule below covers earthmoving and roadworks plant, concrete production, drilling and piling, haulage and lifting, and workshop and site support, held across our Abeokuta, Lagos and Oyo yards.

sections.note: {{CONFIRM: current fleet and quantities — this schedule is transferred from the 2012 equipment register}}

sections.heading: How the fleet is used
sections.intro: Owning the plant is what lets each division control its own programme instead of waiting on a hired-in machine.

items.label: Civil & Infrastructure
items.body: Earthmoving, roadworks and concrete plant for roads, drainage, earthworks and buildings.

items.label: Water Resources
items.body: Drilling rigs, pumps and dredging plant for dams, boreholes, water schemes and river works.
